items.title: Reproduction test: DONE merge with an unrelated uncommitted tracked file in main is wrongly blocked today
items.context: Construct a main worktree with one dirty tracked file UNRELATED to the story's merge scope; drive the DONE merge precondition; assert it is blocked today and (after the fix) proceeds with the unrelated file left untouched. Failing repro per the debugging contract.
items.userSees: A new test fails before the fix (DONE blocked by an unrelated dirty file) and passes after (DONE proceeds; unrelated file preserved); lattice validate green.

happy.desc: repro: DONE precondition blocked by an unrelated dirty tracked file today; proceeds after fix

adversarial.desc: the unrelated dirty file is left byte-identical (not clobbered)

items.title: Scope the DONE merge main-clean precondition to the merge's affected paths
items.context: In the DONE merge precondition (done-effects.ts / cli-engine.ts), block only when a dirty tracked path OVERLAPS the set of paths the merge would change; allow DONE when all dirty paths are unrelated to the merge. Preserve the clobber-protection: still refuse if the merge would touch a dirty path. Do not change DONE merge semantics otherwise.
items.userSees: On a shared main worktree with an unrelated session's uncommitted file, lattice story_advance DONE proceeds and merges; it still refuses if the dirty file is one the merge would overwrite.

happy.desc: precondition allows DONE when dirty paths are unrelated to the merge change set

adversarial.desc: a dirty path overlapping the merge change set still blocks (clobber-protection)

items.title: Tests: unrelated-dirty proceeds + preserved; overlapping-dirty still blocked; clean unchanged
items.context: Cover: (a) unrelated dirty path -> DONE proceeds and the file is byte-identical after; (b) a dirty path that the merge would change -> still blocked (protection preserved); (c) fully clean -> behavior unchanged. Function level.
items.userSees: lattice validate green with tests asserting the three cases (unrelated-allowed, overlapping-blocked, clean-unchanged).
